exposure: Women with PAS who delivered by Cesarean hysterectomy
Women with persistent placenta previa without PAS who delivered by Cesarean section
outcome: Lacunae swirling on grayscale or color Doppler ultrasound
cohort: 21 women with PAS who delivered by Cesarean hysterectomy and 46 women with persistent placenta previa without PAS who delivered by Cesarean section, all of whom had undergone first-trimester ultrasound demonstrating LIP
finding: Ultrasound markers of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), such as placental lacunae, abnormal uteroplacental interface, and lower uterine segment hypervascularity, can be observed as early as the first trimester in women with low-implantation pregnancy.
